method: Read gzip save v8 bytes with independently scoped field schemas; no Unity, entity deserialization hooks, commands, or mutations. Only /tmp/earned-east-audit.json written.
bounds: Snapshots validate owner/state/custody endpoints; source-linked repair/commission causality also relies on ordinary captures and recipe contracts. Baseline Nella precedes raw grain and Claspbean harvest, so this is not an immediate pre-action inventory snapshot.
Working escrow contains exactly2 Emberwheat+1 ClaspbeanPulp; these are spent only by completion, not merely marked in the pack.
The single commissioned meal remains carried and uneaten. HP6 to42 coincides with level1 to2, consistent with full level-up heal; this is not meal-healing acceptance.
IDs are compared semantically across token tables; allocation tokens are local to each save.
This is bounded save evidence, not complete arbitrary-Part-state equality or continuous gameplay proof.
